description: The national literal N"..." and its hexadecimal form NX"..." (ISO §2023:8.3.3.5: "National literals are of the class and category national", 8.3.3.5.1). A COBOL-2002 introduction, QUOTED: ANSI X3.23-1985 says "Every literal belongs to one of two types, nonnumeric or numeric" (§1985:IV.4.2.2.2). Gated position-blind on the TOKEN by LiteralScreen.GateFormat (kb/Work PB5416), because a literal stands in positions that seed no item (an FD VALUE OF, a level-88 VALUE, a SPECIAL-NAMES literal). Its own row, apart from national-data-2002, so the edition diagnostic names the literal and not the PICTURE N / USAGE NATIONAL data the program may not use (kb/Work PB5535).
citation: ISO §2023:8.3.3.5 (National literals); §2023:8.3.3.5.1; §1985:IV.4.2.2.2 (a COBOL-85 literal is nonnumeric or numeric)
vcr: M2 catalog national/boolean; the literal leg of national-data-2002 (kb/Work PB5535)
